description: IAM Access Analyzer's account analyzer is active, and every external access path it finds is on the declared list: the three CI roles federated to GitHub's OIDC provider the pipeline role federated to Google, and the operator's Identity Center role. No public access anywhere

declared.reason: GitHub Actions on main, by immutable owner and repository IDs (pipeline_identity.tf)
The GCP pipeline's service account by numeric ID, through accounts.google.com (cross_cloud.tf)
The operator's sign-in: Identity Center's SAML provider, federated to Google Cloud Identity (identity_center.tf). The suffix is Identity Center's, hence the pattern
